experiment: actual-source symbol and length ambiguity reparsing
source_policy: Only a captured literal space's NUL/space bit5 choice may change. No CR movement, source removal, header replacement, endpoint movement, or arbitrary byte edit is allowed in this arm.

candidate_domain.source_region: First half of the retained block1 body bit interval, using floor((body+endBit)/2).
candidate_domain.enumeration: Every eligible prepared ambiguity bit in ascending stream-bit order, plus identity. No image score or previously successful bit is used to select the domain.

hard_checks: No invalid Huffman symbol or distance beyond available 32768-byte initial history.
Every parsed EOB must end at the unchanged retained source block endpoint.
Headers and all nonselected stream bits remain byte/bit identical.
A bounded decoder output limit of16777216 bytes for the scored blocks; cap failures are recorded, not scored as valid.
dictionary_model: 32768 distinct unknown initial-byte tags; literal values0..255 are constants. Equality is counted only for equal tags or equal constants. Different unknown tags are unresolved, not assumed unequal original bytes.
diagnostics: Nonterminal, nonfirst matches shorter than258 ending at a provably equal next byte; conditional ordinary-zlib diagnostic, not DEFLATE validity.
Provably equal endpoint followed by a literal that can be absorbed more cheaply under the unchanged header.
The subset retaining the same length symbol; exact saved bits.
Token count, output length, Huffman-frequency compatibility, first source-token resynchronization, known-byte and known-endpoint coverage.

selection.training: First source half of block1 only.
shortlists: Best2 valid candidates by cheaper-absorption count / tested matches.
Best2 valid candidates by equal-endpoint count / tested matches.
Best1 valid candidate by same-length-symbol absorption count / tested matches.
selection.union: Deduplicate the three lists, retain identity separately, and retain every scored candidate in the results. Ranking is diagnostic only.

untouched_evaluation.policy: Freeze shortlist before evaluating blocks2–4. Report all shortlisted outcomes, including regressions; do not use heldout results to choose a new winner.
untouched_evaluation.verification: Reprepare each shortlisted change as a recipe.blocks[0].nul toggle, compare exact wire against the one-bit patch, independently inflate using repository codec and native zlib with zero and nonconstant dictionaries, and check unchanged source endpoints/headers and later token continuity.

interpretation: A score decrease is not restored-source authentication or image recovery. Unknown-history coverage and encoder assumptions remain explicit.
